svg.title: AWS runtime reference
svg.desc: Proposed AWS deployment. HTTPS ingress routes browser requests to separate web and Candidates API services on Fargate. MSK carries reference-only events between API and worker. Each service owns a separate RDS database. Worker invokes Bedrock through a private endpoint. API and worker fetch source and results through authenticated Service Connect TLS. This diagram does not depict a live deployment.

text.tspan: Solid: HTTPS / authenticated HTTP / SQL. Dashed: asynchronous event delivery.
API ↔ worker source/result fetches use Service Connect TLS and service tokens.
Status and saved notices return through the same authorized API; signals trigger reconciliation.
